Class Diagnostics

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.gaia.processing.Diagnostics
public final class Diagnostics extends Object
Reports errors, warnings and notes at a precise place in the source: an element, one of its annotations, or one attribute of that annotation. 
diagnostics.on(method).error("must be public");
diagnostics.on(type).annotation("com.example.Mapper").attribute("target").error("must be an interface");

It counts the errors it reports, so a step can report every problem it finds, then skip generating code if there was any.
